The cost-benefit analysis failed due to significant numerical discrepancies in program margins and total annual margin calculations.
The execution failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, test_rows_and_order failed when close(302.4, 4536.0) returned False, indicating a major calculation error in program-level data. Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed with close(-61983.9, -79751.7) returning False, showing the final decision metrics are incorrect. While the environment setup and data loading worked (3 tests passed), the logic for 'total_annual_margin_10_day_usd' and individual program codes must be re-evaluated.
